title: material_palette
description: The `material_palette` content kind (megaplan 1.7, tasks 3-A1 and 3-R1): which replica block a Night City cell becomes. One entry per file, read by the replica's Palette loader. With `code` (1..26, the shared material codes of shared/protocol.md and shared/vectors.json `materials`: 1..10 concrete_light, concrete_dark, asphalt, sidewalk, glass, metal, brick, tile, ground, water, 11..26 neon in vanilla dye order) the entry maps the material code a `ground.m` entry carries to `block`. With `heuristic` it gives the block of one heuristic class, used for a cell whose code is 0 (no material readable, Phase 0 b): street, sidewalk, roof, offroad (a street in an outskirts district), wall_base, wall_brick (a wall base in a brick district), wall_trim, wall_window, wall, water (the shared map's water flag). With neither it maps the block's own code to the block. The server only receives codes, never material names: the names-to-codes table lives in shared/ (tools/cbmath.py). `colour` is the block's representative map colour. `block` must be a `cyberblock:nc_*` replica block, or the loader skips the entry. A file with the same id as a default replaces it; the loader has the defaults built in, so a datapack ships only the entries it changes.
